task_description: Implements a linear search algorithm to find the first element satisfying a specific condition in an array or sequence. `LinearSearch` and `LinearSearch1` perform forward searches, locating elements satisfying predicate P over the entire array and within a specified range, respectively; `LinearSearch2` and `LinearSearch3` perform reverse searches, finding specific elements in reverse-stored sequences, returning the position or -1 if not found. All methods ensure the correctness and completeness of search results through postconditions.
method_signature: method LinearSearch<T>(a: array<T>, P: T -> bool) returns (n: int)
